settlement_source: Contract terms: Source Agencies = State of California plus 16 media orgs (NYT, AP, Bloomberg, Reuters, Axios, Politico, Semafor, The Information, WaPo, WSJ, ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox, MSNBC, NBC); payout says official election results produced by the state determine the winner
settlement_variable: Identity of the person elected governor of California in the 2026 election; YES if named candidate is that person
timezone: ET (expiration 10:00 AM ET); election night in PT
tie_handling: unknown (not specified in terms; recount/tie not addressed)
rounding: n/a (categorical outcome; $1.00 settlement value, min tick per contract terms)
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last trading time = expiration time (10:00 AM ET on Expiration Date); Expiration Date at latest 1 year after election, sooner on payout event/accelerated determination; settle no later than next day unless under review
early_close_or_void_clauses: Accelerated resolution when >=4 of 8 Designated Media Sources (NYT, AP, DDHQ, CNN, Fox, NBC, CBS, ABC) call a winner with none contradicting; 'unambiguous statement in a news article' counts; affiliate call can represent network; Exchange may replace a source at its sole discretion. Contingencies: Kalshi may open Market Outcome Review at sole discretion; if expiration value cannot be determined Kalshi may set payouts per Rule 6.3(b).
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'Who will win the governorship' vs rules 'is elected ... pursuant to the election in 2026' - OK, but accelerated clause lets media calls decide before official CA SoS certification
Settlement sources listed on API are media outlets; contract text says official state results determine winner - dual standard
California top-two primary system: general election may feature same-party or non-major candidates

toxicity_flags: Accelerated determination keyed to media calls: resolution can occur before official results/certification; a miscall or premature article could trigger it
Exchange discretionary Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3) before settlement
Insider-information risk class: campaign/vote-tally/decision-desk staff prohibited, implying informed flow near calls
Long lag between call and official certification (CA counts slowly) widens window for contradictory calls
